publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Review-only scientific algorithmic anatomical or pathology reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, patient record, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: NLM MeSH supplies controlled condition identity and scope; official NIH and CDC sources supply conservative anatomical and communication boundaries only. No source image or design is copied.

reviewStandard: Current controlled condition identity, anatomically conservative and non-diagnostic representation, non-stigmatizing communication, complete pale edge field, crop-safe geometry, exact prompt, and any prior failure evidence must be frozen before exactly one generation call per cleared revision. Observed output controls later metadata.
promotionRule: No output may receive a registry key, public master, derivative, endpoint, schema node, or sitemap entry before immutable native-resolution review and exact-hash Control Tower acceptance.
